abort.single_boiler: Only one boiler management is allowed.

data_description.allowed_modes: Defines the modes offered by the zone (heating, cooling or both).
data_description.cycle_minutes: Recalculation period of the percentage. Also the measurement window for learning.
data_description.max_sensor_age: With no new sensor value for this long, the zone goes into 'sensor failure'.
data_description.failsafe_power: 0 = the zone requests nothing if the sensor is missing.
data_description.boiler_fraction_entity: Boiler power = heating power × fraction. Empty = 100 %.
data_description.season_entity: Auto mode: when on (summer) the zone cools, otherwise it heats. Empty = the sense follows the temperature (below the heating setpoint: heat; above the cooling setpoint: cool; in between: dead band).
data_description.valve_entities: number entities: the zone writes the opening (%) = boiler fraction, in winter only. Nothing is sent when off, cooling or in summer, nor if the valve already has the right value.

data.offset_next_full: Reduction after a hot cycle (0 = off)

data_description.min_power: Below this percentage the zone requests nothing: avoids useless tiny demands.
data_description.limit_cycles: Once heating, the zone only stops below 1 % (instead of the minimum power).
data_description.autolearn: The zone tunes its own coefficients from the room's real temperature rise. Turn off to freeze them.
data_description.threshold_hot: If the previous cycle went above this percentage the radiator is still hot: the next cycle is reduced (see reduction below).
data_description.offset_next_full: Percentage removed from the next cycle after a very hot one, to account for radiator inertia. 0 = off.
data_description.fail_offset_heat: If the zone heats but the temperature stays more than X °C below the setpoint and keeps falling, 2 cycles in a row: 'heating failure'.
data_description.fail_offset_cool: Same detection for cooling: temperature more than X °C above the setpoint and rising, 2 cycles in a row.

data_description.windows: Opening sensors: the zone stops when one stays open.
data_description.window_stop_delay: How long a window stays open before the zone stops.
data_description.window_restart_delay: Delay after closing before regulation resumes.

data_description.power_sources: sensor / number / input_number entities: a zone, or any other source you add.

data_description.post_run_minutes: 0 = circulator stops as soon as demand drops to 0.

data_description.start_delay: Minimum time since the last change before switching the AC on.
data_description.adjust_interval: Minimum time between two setpoint changes.
data_description.ac_min_on: Minimum run time before switching off (protects the compressor).
data_description.mode_delay: Pause between the mode change and the setpoint.
